login.title: Two-step verification
login.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.code_help: Codes change every 30 seconds. A recovery code looks like xxxxx-xxxxx and works once.
login.cancel: Sign in with a different account
login.invalid: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
login.expired: This sign-in step has expired or was used. Enter your password again.
setup.title: Two-factor authentication
setup.subtitle: Ask for a code from your phone after your password, so a stolen password alone cannot open your account.
setup.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue using the dashboard.
setup.invalid: That code does not match. Make sure the app shows this account and the phone clock is correct.
status.title: Status
status.recovery_low: Few recovery codes are left. Create new ones and store them safely.
start.lead: You will need an authenticator app such as Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
start.scope: It applies to signing in to the dashboard with a password or a sign-in link. API keys and MCP agents are not affected.
start.confirm: Confirm your password to set it up
enrol.title: Add this account to your authenticator app
enrol.step_app: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this QR code. Or enter the setup key, or open the link on this device.
enrol.qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
enrol.qr_help: Scan it with your authenticator app. Anyone who sees this code can create your sign-in codes: do not share it or keep a screenshot.
enrol.settings: Type: time-based (TOTP), 6 digits, every 30 seconds, SHA-1.
enrol.code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.lead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once instead of an app code. Store them in a password manager or print them.
codes.once: These codes are shown only now. Creating new codes replaces all of them.
regen.title: Recovery codes
regen.lead: Create a new set of ten codes. The old codes stop working.
disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication
disable.lead: Signing in will ask only for your password again. Enter your password and a current code.
disable.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication, so it cannot be turned off. An administrator can reset it if you lose your phone.
enforce.title: Require two-factor authentication
enforce.lead: Members of the selected roles must set up an authenticator app before they can use the dashboard.
enforce.scope: Applies at the next page load, including to people already signed in. API keys and MCP agents are not affected.
